ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious NTLM Authentication on the Printer Spooler Service
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a privilege elevation attempt by coercing NTLM authentication on the Printer Spooler service

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\davclnt\\\.dll\\,DavSetCookie.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*spoolss.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*srvsvc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/print\\/pipe\\/.*"))))
